notes:
Garage61 compatibility, and the new icon rendering.

- Connect your own Garage61 account: Activate → Garage61, paste a personal access token from garage61.net/developer, and its laps appear in the reference picker under "Your Garage61 account". The laps GOAT itself supplies come from GOAT and the GOAT drivers community; GOAT never uses a shared Garage61 account.
- The app icon is now drawn exactly as the website draws the ring mark (one amber gradient stroke); the older two-tone rendering is retired everywhere.
